flows.title: Publish a site
steps: In your site (or Site settings), click Publish.
Check the domain(s) you want to publish to.

flows.title: Add a CMS collection item
steps: Click the Collection you'd like to add an item to.
Click New [Collection item] (for example, New Blog Post).
Click Create draft to save it.

flows.title: Add a page
steps: Click the Create new page icon, then click New page.
Type a page name in the Page name field.
Click Create (or click the arrow on the Create button to save it as a draft).
